title: Affordance library and traversal-graph export
summary: Map surface classes to traversal verbs (the affordance library) and export the traversal graph: which surfaces reach which, by which verb, at what difficulty. Each edge carries verb, capability cost (distance/height/angle in A-units), entry + surface prerequisites, and a T0–T3 difficulty tier (SPEC §3.4). Tool verbs (grapple swing/ascend/rappel, pole-vault, wall-run) are added the same way as any IVerbProvider verb. traversal_graph schema fields are frozen by M1-DATA-01.

acceptance_tests.test: The affordance library maps each Bible §4 class to its enabled verbs (Bible §4 matrix); the traversal graph exports nodes and edges into traversal_graph.json, each edge tagged with its verb, T0–T3 difficulty tier, capability cost, and entry + surface prerequisites.
Schema-validates; a test confirms every edge's verb is enabled for the source surface class.
The affordance mapping lives in one place, consumed by both the graph export and the validator.

Tool verbs (grapple swing/ascend/rappel, pole-vault, wall-run) appear as edges through the same affordance mapping, each recording its config/movement.json prerequisites on the edge (grapple anchor reach + min ledge, pole-vault plant window + max gap, wall-run min entry speed + min wall length).

history.event: sharpened under AUTH #023 (journey generation v1): edges carry T0–T3 difficulty tier, capability cost, and prerequisites; tool verbs (grapple/pole-vault/wall-run) added via the same affordance mapping (AT-4).
